text:
Anna: Quick sync — product wants to lock onboarding SLA for the new LlamaX family. Need bench gates + pin policy proposal by EOD Thu. Can we sketch constraints? :eyes:

Raj: Will do. Do we have customer-driven exceptions already (e.g., enterprise pins)?

Miranda: Yes — two enterprise accounts asked for pin-for-6mo. Also flagged quality mismatch on v2 -> v3 migrations.

Luis: From CS — ask is staged rollout with opt-in migration window + compensation credits. Customers want guaranteed p95 latency.

Anna: Proposal idea: non-enterprise users auto-upgrade after 30d; enterprise can opt for 6mo pin with SLA uplift. Need bench thresholds to gate auto-upgrade.

Raj: Bench idea (draft):
```
bench_accept:
  p95_latency_ms <= 120
  token_cost_usd_per_1k <= 0.65
  semantic_similarity >= 0.92 (task-specific eval)
  regression <= 0.5% over golden prompts
```
We'll need test harness to measure drift.

Miranda: For semantic similarity, prefer population-weighted evals by tenant. Also add embedding drift checks for retrieval use-cases.

Sam: Ops: We need canary lanes + rollback criteria. Suggest 5% traffic canary for 48h + automatic rollback if error_rate > 1% or p95 degrades > +20%.

Anna: Sounds good. Two tradeoffs: speed to onboard vs. labor for per-tenant evals. Can we scope a lightweight path for low-risk models?

Raj: Yes — lightweight path: black-box smoke tests + synthetic latency/throughput bench. Full gate only for pinned/enterprise models.

Luis: Also need comms template for customers pinned: timeline, opt-in steps, and how to request emergency rollback.

Miranda: I'll produce an eval matrix prototype and examples for retrieval vs. open-ended generation by EOD Wed.

Anna: Great — I'll draft the contract language for pin exceptions + credit tiers. Ping me if the bench numbers change. cc @Miranda @Raj :thumbsup:

ops-bot: canary-deployment started for model llmx-v3-canary at 3501234578 — 5% traffic.
